description: Return which paperwork a waste movement needs: in the UK from the nation and whether the waste is hazardous, or any listed document by id, including Ireland, the Netherlands, the US, Canada and Australia. A document id takes precedence when both forms are supplied. Results cover the document, parties, the items the preparation tool asks for, retention, pre-notification where it applies, electronic and signature status, regulator route, the ComplyOnSite tool that prepares it, and source lineage. Preparation tools do not issue, submit or confirm acceptance of official documents.

detail.description: With document: also return the form’s full field, guide and FAQ specification. Large; only when filling the form in.

document.description: A document id returned by this tool, for example us-asbestos-wsr or sct-special-waste.

hazardous.description: Whether the waste is hazardous; use together with jurisdiction.

jurisdiction.description: UK jurisdiction; use together with hazardous, or omit both to list documents.

name: waste_paperwork

limit.description: What the result does not establish.

source.description: ComplyOnSite page that shows the same answer.

summary.description: The answer in one to three plain sentences, the figure or code first.

title: Check waste paperwork requirements
